**Finding: compliant** (rule INSURANCE, severity low)

Section 18 already meets our preferred position in full, so no redline was proposed:

- **CGL** — USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate ✓
- **Professional E&O** — USD 2M ✓
- **Cyber/privacy** — USD 5M, appropriate as Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data ✓
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law, plus USD 1M employer's liability (extra beyond our ask) ✓
- **Certificates** — provided on request, plus advance notice of cancellation/material reduction ✓
- **Duration** — term plus one year, matching our model language ✓

Clause 18.2 also confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, which preserves our position under the liability and indemnity sections. Nothing to negotiate here.
